    • fetchDashboardMetrics

      public void fetchDashboardMetrics(long fromMs, long toMs, Consumer<List<Event>> onEventsLoaded, Consumer<DashboardMetrics> onSuccess, Consumer<String> onError)
      Fetches all events and users in parallel, then computes dashboard metrics.
      Parameters:
      fromMs - start of date range filter (epoch ms, inclusive); 0 = all-time
      toMs - end of date range filter (epoch ms, inclusive); Long.MAX_VALUE = all-time
      onEventsLoaded - called with the full (unfiltered) event list for CSV export caching
      onSuccess - called with computed DashboardMetrics
      onError - called with an error message if either Firestore call fails
